Language: en

This case-sensitive code system http://ahip.org/demographics/CodeSystem/ahip-demo-additional-care-consideration-codes defines the following codes:

CodeDisplay
HEBE Health beliefs
CUPR Cultural preferences
REBE Religious beliefs (e.g., no blood transfusions, need or want particular people in the room with you or before procedures or for end of life rituals, etc.)
SPBE Spiritual beliefs
DIET Specific diet followed (e.g., Halal, Kosher, Pescatarian, Vegetarian, Vegan)
CARE Caregiving status
